| style='width: 35px; text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 6
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He reasoneth of Manna, and of the true bread from heauen.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=THE 3 PASCHE.}}
|-

| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 7
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He reprehendeth the Pharisees for cauilling at his disciples because they did eate vvith vnvvashed handes.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |

| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He healeth the daughter of the vvoman of Canaan.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 7
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He cureth a man that vvas deafe and dumme.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 15
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 8
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He feedeth 4000 vvith seuen loaues.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 16
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 8
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He reiecteth the Pharisees that asked a signe, and biddeth his disciples bevvare of their leauen.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 8
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He healeth a blinde man in Bethsaida.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 16
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 8
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | The time that he vvil passe out of this vvorld, novv dravving nigh, he maketh Peter, for confessing him to be Christ, the Rocke vpon vvhich he vvil build his Church, promising to giue him the keies of heauen, and vvithal foretelleth, that he must suffer in Hierusalem, and that al must be ready to suffer vvith him.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The 4 part, from the time that he began (Mat. 16, 21) to foretel to his Disciples, that he must goe &amp; suffer in Hierusalem.}}
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 17
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | The Transfiguration.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He casteth out the diuel vvhich his disciples could not cast out, commending vnto them fasting and praier.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 17
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He paieth the didrachmes for him and Peter, after that Peter had found a stater in the fishes mouth.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 18
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | His disciples contending for Superioritie, he teacheth humilitie.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 18
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He threateneth the scandalizers of litle ones.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 18
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He teacheth vs to forgiue our brother sinning against vs.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 19
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 10
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 7
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Leauing Galilee he goeth into Iurie, and the Samaritanes vvil not receiue him.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The 5 part, of his going into Ievvrie toward his Passion.}}
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 17
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | In that iourney he healeth the ten lepers.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 7
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He teacheth in the Temple in the feast of Scenopégia, that is, of Tabernacles.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 8
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He absolueth the vvoman taken in aduoutrie, teacheth in the Temple, and goeth out of their handes that vvould haue stoned him.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He restoreth sight to him that vvas borne blinde.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 10
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He reasoneth of the true Pastor and his sheepe.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 10
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He sendeth the 70 disciples, and they returne. The parable of the Samaritane and the vvounded man. Martha entertaineth Iesus.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 11
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He teacheth the maner and force of praier, and reprehendeth the preposterous cleannesse of the Pharisees.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 12
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He teacheth not to feare them that kil the body onely, to cast avvay the care of riches by the parable of him that thought his barnes to litle, and that the faithful seruant vvil alwaies expect the comming of his lord and maister.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 13
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He threateneth them, vnles they doe penance, shewing Gods patience by the fruitles figtree that vvas suffered to stand one yere more. He healeth the crooked vvoman, teacheth the vvay to heauen to be narrovv.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 14
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He healeth him that had a dropsie, on the Sabboth: and teacheth them to renounce al things in comparison of him.
